sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows leucovorin calcium is not currently listed as of 2026-10-21.
The earliest posting in FDA's database is 2012-01-01, which is the database start date.
Corvale East has 2.7 days of the 50 mg/5 mL injection on hand, Corvale General has 23.2 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 24.5 days.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 8 vials of 50 mg/5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 5 days on hand while Corvale Lakeside retains 14 days.
This transfer requires a pharmacy director transfer request.
